To keep these in the forecast we need either: (A) clear owner confirmation + close evidence (PO, signed SOW, email commit) or (B) mark the opp as Shelved/De-prioritized before EOD next Friday.

Opps in scope (SF IDs):
- MV-231 — $165k ARR — Stage: Commit
- MV-233 — $48k ARR — Stage: Commit
- MV-236 — $29k ARR — Stage: Commit

Attached is a short template for evidence to speed things up: close_evidence_template.pdf

Ben / Naomi / Rishi — please claim ownership in SF for the opps you are owning and update the Close Date or change Stage to Shelved if you do not have confirmation. We’ll reconcile with finance on Monday.

Thanks — appreciate quick replies here so the forecast scrub stays clean.
